scope: Real isolated Chromium on macOS; JS and Dart WASM clients with a dedicated JS SQLite worker. Correctness checks, not throughput benchmarks. Updated direct selection decoding and fixed-length relation row expansion exercise six-field mixed types, deferred mapping/order, memberships, plan and phase observations, query/row counts, OPFS persistence, reload recovery and upgrades.
